frozen_flag_meaning: The manifest's frozen=true flag is the manifest-schema requirement that this selection is hash-pinned: every case file is bound to a SHA-256 of its raw working-tree bytes and the loader refuses the selection if any byte moves. It does NOT mean the benchmark is scientifically final. The release status is release-candidate.

supersedes.reason: Phase-K offline forensic redesign following the committed Phase-I QA-OFF requalification, whose protocol verdict was HOLD_POST_FREEZE_DEFECT and whose analyzer verdict was HOLD. Seven rc2 challenge tasks recorded zero canonical exposure, FAULT-003 reached its fault path in only 5/6 cells, and one cell recorded a MODEL_PROTOCOL_INVALID adapter rejection. Forensic inspection attributed these to construct defects and to one systemic missing-sink defect rather than to instrument failure: the adapter behaved correctly in the one malformed-argument cell, and BUD-013's Phase-H modality repair worked in full. rc3 repairs those constructs, preserves the nine tasks that needed no repair, and records predecessor-to-successor mapping explicitly. UA-004 is retained unedited as a deliberate negative control.
supersedes.observation_note: pilot-v7-rc2 WAS observed by real models in Phase I under QA OFF; that is precisely the evidence this redesign responds to. rc2 itself was not edited, its results were not re-run or reinterpreted as qualification evidence, and no rc3 task has been observed by any model.
supersedes.predecessor_evidence_protocol_note: Phase-I evidence is usable as diagnostic evidence but is not protocol-pristine. Its frozen plan required an immediate stop once any defect was discovered; a MODEL_PROTOCOL_INVALID cell was discovered after the Qwen arm completed and the Mistral arm was launched 28.4 seconds later anyway. The Qwen arm is therefore pre-discovery diagnostic evidence and the Mistral arm is post-stop diagnostic continuation. Phase K preserves that distinction, uses neither partition as qualification evidence, and does not rewrite Phase-I history.

hash_basis: raw working-tree bytes, LF canonical checkout per docs/hash_basis_policy.md
preregistration_note: pilot-v7-rc3 is a release candidate and deliberately carries NO preregistration. Preregistration v3 remains bound to the frozen pilot-v6.1 benchmark and preregistration v1 to its own scope; both are unchanged and neither is extended to rc3. No preregistration v4 exists or is created by this phase.
